reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual re-review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; prior external-01 review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source visibly has dark eyebrows beneath the visor shadow, while external-02 leaves the area above both eyes completely smooth without eyebrows. Restore the source-scale dark eyebrows while preserving the successfully repaired two-row note.
entries.positive_observation: The note repair is successful: exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows remain, with two small gray groups per row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The olive peaked cap with gold front/visor decoration, covered hair, one restrained closed mouth, smooth chin and absence of added glasses or facial hair remain. The near-frontal slightly viewer-left pose, red/gold collar patches, gold shoulder trim and small central collar area remain. The rounded lower head meets a short broad collar. The complete tilted frame, opaque muted gray-olive backing, warm-cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The missing dark eyebrows are the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Very fine upper-lip hair/eyewear, tiny cap/collar symbols and the small central ribbon/pendant construction are not fully legible in the source; none is used as an additional rejection reason. The missing dark eyebrow group is clearly visible rather than an unresolved fine detail.
